confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Manila price levels for July 2026; not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine glass anchors use the beer anchor as a cross-check (about 3x and 3.5x beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. FX 0.7002 (14 Oct 2026) comes from search-result summaries of the RBA page, not the F11.1 data file; if the 14 Oct entry is not yet published, the 13 Oct figure of 0.6961 is the latest available.
comparable_city_reasoning: SEA regional basis, loosely benchmarked against Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur for dining, drinks, and hotel tiers; Manila's local beer runs cheaper than those cities, while mid-range dining and 3-star hotels sit near them.
